item.title: Verbose beta 309
item.description:
Recordings you can trust, and an app that keeps up

Mac

  • The start sound plays before recording, so your first words are never cut. Recording keeps everything from the moment the sound ends.
  • A finished transcript shows its text right away, with Ready on top. Nothing waits for the celebration, and a tap ends it. On iPhone, the recorder closes as soon as it saves.
  • Deleting from Recently Deleted asks before it's gone for good. A full swipe no longer deletes a recording permanently.
  • Stop and transcribe with ⌥⇧. on any screen, and find every shortcut in the menu bar. Dictation has Dictate, New thought, and Recent dictations, so Help's search finds them.
  • ⌘F finds words in the open transcript, with matches highlighted. ⌘G and ⇧⌘G step through matches and Esc closes. Elsewhere ⌘F opens Search or ask.
  • ⌘Z undoes a Clean up, Tone, or fix, and ⇧⌘Z redoes it. Typing numbers in Recent dictations searches; ⌘ and a number copies one.
  • At the smallest window nothing is cut short: toolbars fold into More and chips wrap. The inspector steps aside when content gets too narrow, and the Library drops People, then Date.
  • VoiceOver reads every message, and an Undo waits for you while VoiceOver is on. On iPhone, messages appear above the tab bar, clear of Back and More, and Undo is easier to tap.
  • Caption history, voice setup, dark swipe actions, and the Ribbon's Stop read more clearly. With Reduce Motion, the Ribbon and notch stop changing shape and only fade.

Also on iPhone

  • Undo and Use as spoken change only the words Verbose just inserted.
  • Stop saves and transcribes every live captions session.
  • If Verbose stops updating, the Lock Screen asks you to open it instead of running a clock.
  • Turn Verbose's sounds and haptics on or off separately.
  • Settings, widgets, the Lock Screen, captions, and the watch grow with your text size.
  • Apple Watch says Saved on Watch until your iPhone has the recording.
